explanation: The ℤ-action is forced by additivity: n·m = m + ⋯ + m (n times), so specifying a ℤ-module adds nothing beyond the abelian group structure. This is why the structure theorem over the PID ℤ specializes to the fundamental theorem of finitely generated abelian groups.
